A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CutS3D, with matching authors, core components, and experiments. All pages are readable. v3 includes supplementary Sections A–E; the supplied v1 ends after its references despite mentioning supplementary material. Comparisons concern what is present in these PDFs.

before.justification: v1 reports original instance-segmentation and object-detection results, in-domain self-training experiments, and component ablations in Tables 1–8.

after.justification: v3 reports original benchmark results and ablations, including additional training-round comparisons, depth experiments, and ImageNet pseudo-mask evaluation.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 revises the stated LocalCut procedure: v1 retains only points inside the semantic cut, whereas v3 assigns background z-coordinates to points outside it. This is a localized procedural revision; the three principal components, detector architecture, and loss remain.

E1.justification: OpenImages object-detection evaluation is removed from Section 4 and Table 2. ImageNet training and the remaining COCO, COCO20K, LVIS, VOC, Objects365, and KITTI coverage remain. The added ImageNet validation experiment evaluates an existing domain rather than introducing another domain.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds UnSAM and removes LOST and MaskDistill, while retaining the principal competing methods. v3 also includes CutLER in the training-round comparison (Table 5) and MaskCut in the direct pseudo-mask comparison (Table 14), extending comparator participation beyond the corresponding v1 analyses.

E3.justification: The main evaluation changes from one to three self-training rounds, with explicit comparisons across matched backbones and rounds in Table 5. v3 adds ImageNet validation bounding-box evaluation and size-specific AP and recall reporting. However, Appendix E.3 and Table 17 still specify one self-training round, conflicting with the main protocol.

E4.justification: v3 adds SIS-only and CRF-versus-depth confidence controls, a lower-quality MiDaS depth test, extended Kick Back & Relax training, direct pseudo-mask evaluation, and qualitative failure analyses. Conversely, Table 4 drops the DINO component-ablation results. The confidence-floor and mask-alignment tests are moved from v1 Table 5 to v3 Table 10, not newly introduced.

E5.justification: Neither PDF reports independent repeated-run counts, random seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Additional self-training rounds are sequential training stages; Spatial Confidence measures pseudo-mask confidence rather than uncertainty in experimental estimates.

E6.justification: Table 1 replaces the DiffNCuts model's COCO val2017/COCO20K mask AP of 10.2/10.3 with 10.7/10.9 under increased self-training, so these are not same-setting gains. In-domain LVIS mask AP changes from 5.6 to 4.5 in Table 3. Numerous roundwise, depth, confidence, pseudo-mask, and detailed AP/recall results are also added.

T1.justification: The NCut/min-cut formulation, confidence definitions, and loss mathematics remain substantively unchanged, with no new proofs or derivations. v3 repairs the malformed typesetting of Equation 2's already-described normalization to [beta, 1]; this does not introduce a different normalization principle.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central claims: using 3D information for 2D unsupervised instance segmentation through LocalCut, Spatial Importance Sharpening, and Spatial Confidence, with improved benchmark performance. Updated margins and additional experiments support these retained claims.

C2.justification: Section 5 adds interpretations concerning robustness to imperfect depth and CutLER's plateau under matched training. The appendix explains the confidence-source comparison, identifies initial semantic-cut failures, and qualifies pseudo-mask evaluation through ImageNet's limited box annotations. The main limitations concerning indistinct boundaries, small objects, and unavailable depth remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Unlike v1's references to unavailable supplementary settings, v3 supplies extraction thresholds, batch sizes, learning rates, optimization, initialization, augmentation, and training budgets in Appendix E and Tables 15–17. It also adds a project-page link, a configuration-file availability statement, and computational-overhead figures. These are substantial disclosures, although the one-versus-three-round inconsistency limits reproducibility.

R1.justification: v3 adds SAM and UnSAM references and distinguishes UnSAM's multi-granularity discovery objective from precise instance segmentation. It removes the dedicated LOST description and OpenImages reference. The broader positioning around CutLER, self-supervised features, and 3D information remains.

P1.justification: The main section sequence and much of the abstract, introduction, method, and conclusion remain intact. Changes include localized rewriting and condensation, reorganized ablation discussion, a structured supplement, updated affiliations, and acknowledgements; there is no wholesale narrative rewrite.

P2.justification: v3 adds a first-page qualitative/bar-chart overview, redraws the Spatial Confidence diagram, restructures comparison tables with difference rows and revised columns, and adds extensive appendix tables and visualizations. Existing confidence ablations are relocated, and Equation 2's rendering is repaired. These substantially change the visual presentation.

improvement.justification: v3 substantially strengthens experimental support and technical documentation. Matched backbone/training-round comparisons, confidence-source controls, depth-quality tests, and direct pseudo-mask evaluation better test the proposed mechanisms, while the appendix supplies settings absent from the supplied v1. These gains outweigh the reduced OpenImages coverage and documentation inconsistencies, although the conflicting self-training schedules and occasional table discrepancies still require correction.
